title: Merge of gnupg2 from Debian unstable (2.4.9-4) into Ubuntu stonking (LP: #2154019).
description:
Merge of gnupg2 from Debian unstable (2.4.9-4) into Ubuntu stonking (LP: #2154019).

Dropped changes (fixed upstream in Debian):

 - CVE-2025-68973.patch: memory corruption fix in armor parser (fixed in 2.4.9-1)
 - CVE-2026-24882.patch: stack-based buffer overflow fix in tpm2daemon (fixed in 2.4.9-2)

Retained Ubuntu delta:

 - Honor http_proxy= env var by default in the systemd user session dirmngr service
 - Don't build gpgv-win32 (only used by debian-installer)
 - Demote gnupg-l10n to Recommends
 - Demote all gnupg Recommends to Suggests
 - Stop building gpg-wks-server and gpg-wks-client on i386
 - Demote gpg-wks-client to Recommends
 - gpg/gpgsm: Recommend gpg-agent and dirmngr
 - Disable swtpm/libtss2-dev build-dep on i386

PPA: ppa:varranvar/gnupg2-merge-2154019

Local autopkgtest results (since autopkgtest is down):

simple-tests         PASS
migration            PASS
emacs-epg-message-mode PASS

index 0000000..06348f9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/ubuntu/honor-http-proxy.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+Description: Honor http_proxy= environment variables by default in the systemd user session dirmngr service
+Author: Julian Andres Klode <julian.klode@canonical.com>
+--- a/doc/examples/systemd-user/dirmngr.service
++++ b/doc/examples/systemd-user/dirmngr.service
+@@ -4,5 +4,5 @@ Documentation=man:dirmngr(8)
+ Requires=dirmngr.socket
+ 
+ [Service]
+-ExecStart=/usr/bin/dirmngr --supervised
++ExecStart=/usr/bin/dirmngr --supervised --honor-http-proxy
+ ExecReload=/usr/bin/gpgconf --reload dirmngr
